SELECT c.username as userName, CASE WHEN c.alias IS NULL OR c.alias = '' THEN c.username ELSE c.alias END AS alias, c.remark as remark, c.nick_name as nickName, '' as labelIdList, c.description as describe, NULL as headImgUrl FROM contact c WHERE c.local_type % 2 = 1 AND c.verify_flag = 0 AND c.username NOT IN ( 'floatbottle', 'fmessage', 'medianote','filehelper' ) AND c.username NOT LIKE '%@chatroom'
AND c.remark LIKE '%' || #{contactDTO.remark} || '%'
AND c.nick_name LIKE '%' || #{contactDTO.nickName} || '%'
AND 1 = 0
AND c.description LIKE '%' || #{contactDTO.describe} || '%'
ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(c.remark_pin_yin_initial, ''), c.pin_yin_initial)

SELECT c.username as userName, CASE WHEN c.remark IS NULL OR c.remark = '' THEN c.nick_name ELSE c.remark END AS nickName FROM contact c WHERE c.local_type % 2 = 1 AND c.verify_flag = 0 AND c.username NOT IN ( 'floatbottle', 'fmessage', 'medianote','filehelper' ) AND c.username NOT LIKE '%@chatroom' ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(c.remark_pin_yin_initial, ''), c.pin_yin_initial)

SELECT CASE WHEN c.alias IS NULL OR c.alias = '' THEN c.username ELSE c.alias END AS alias FROM contact c WHERE c.local_type % 2 = 1 AND c.verify_flag = 0 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN c.alias IS NULL OR c.alias = '' THEN c.username ELSE c.alias END AS alias FROM contact c WHERE c.username LIKE 'gh_%' AND c.alias <> ''
SELECT count(*) FROM contact c WHERE c.local_type % 2 = 1 AND c.verify_flag = 0 AND c.username NOT IN ( 'floatbottle', 'fmessage', 'medianote','filehelper' ) AND c.username NOT LIKE '%@chatroom';
